Units 1-3 match: 21-day CalendarRule query; count back from yesterday skipping listed days; exact-midnight match via dt.Select(currDate.ToString()); no match => 3 calendar days.

All units re-derived: connection {B1F06256...} = [Psql]; DateTime.Now.AddDays(-1).Date; dt.Select exact match; threeWorkingDays = 2, break at 0 else --; loop i < 21; result written to Dts.Variables["LastThreeWorkingDays"] only on success; catch sets Failure but line 104 sets Success unconditionally, so on exception the variable keeps its design value 10/3/2017 1:52:22 PM (no configurations; Get Variables From Etl Variables writes only OrganizationName/ServerName).
Population (CalendarRule, 3 names, last 21 days UTC), decisions and no CRM write (variable only) match.
Condition result == null || result.Length <= 0 -> break at 0 else decrement matches lines 121-129; outcome traced.
Matches SQL and SDK update to 11; meaning of gen_SendToBankDate attributed to the field name.

Units 1-3 match: status 7, date not null and on/before threshold (day-level datediff), SDK update to 11; on exception DirectRowToError to an unconnected output, so the request stays in status 7. Meanings attributed.

Units 1, 2 and 4-11 match the DTSX (SQL, parameter = User::LastThreeWorkingDays, Derived Column 11, SDK Update, catch -> DirectRowToError with the Error output unconnected, threshold wording). Unit 3 states "שום שדה אחר לא משתנה" (no other field changes). The code only proves that the Entity sent contains gen_tanferinstatus alone (main.cs 118-122). Whether other fields change in CRM is not shown in the files: the platform itself sets modifiedon/modifiedby on every SDK Update (documented CRM behaviour), and plugins/workflows on gen_transferrequest are outside the supplied scope. The absolute statement is therefore an unproven fact.
